summary:
Rula Lenska, born Roza Maria Leopoldyna Lubienski in 1947, is a British actress of Polish noble descent. She trained at the Webber-Douglas School of Drama and began acting in the 1960s. Her early work included the television series *Rock Follies* and the film *Queen Kong*. Alberto VO5 adverts made her familiar to US audiences in the late 1970s, though she was little known there; the ads became a subject of jokes on US television.

Lenska worked extensively in British theatre, alongside television and film roles. She played Claudia Colby in *Coronation Street* from 2009 to 2011, returning between 2018 and 2022, and appeared in *Celebrity Big Brother* in 2006. Her autobiography, *Rula: My Colourful Life*, was published in 2013.

She has one daughter from her marriage to actor Brian Deacon, which ended in divorce in 1987. Her second marriage, to actor Dennis Waterman, lasted from 1987 to 1998 and also ended in divorce. Lenska later said Waterman had assaulted her; he acknowledged hitting her in a 2012 interview. In 2016, she received a driving ban after a drink-driving crash.
